name.text: Writing equations of graphs resulting from given transformations

questiontext.text:
Starting with the graph of \(f(x)=e^{{@coeff_x@}x}\), sketch the graph by dragging the sliders of the graph that results from,

a) Reflecting about the x-axis,

[[jsxgraph input-ref-ansa='ansaRef' input-ref-ansb='ansbRef']] JXG.Options.text.useMathJax = true; var board = JXG.JSXGraph.initBoard('jxgbox', {boundingbox: [-8, 8, 8, -8], axis:true, showCopyright:false, showNavigation:true }); var a = board.create('slider',[[-4,-2],[3,-2],[-5,1,5]],{name:'a', snapWidth:1}); var b = board.create('slider',[[-4,-3],[3,-3],[-5,{#coeff_x+1#},5]],{name:'b', snapWidth:1}); var graph2 = board.create('functiongraph', [function(t) {return a.Value() * JXG.Math.pow(Math.E, t * b.Value());}],{strokeColor:'#ff0000'}); var text = board.create('text',[-5,5, function() { return '\\[f(x) = ' + a.Value() + 'e^{' + b.Value() + 'x}\\]'; }]); stack_jxg.bind_slider(ansaRef, a); stack_jxg.bind_slider(ansbRef, b); board.update(); [[/jsxgraph]]

[[input:ansa]] [[validation:ansa]][[feedback:prta]]

[[input:ansb]] [[validation:ansb]][[feedback:prtb]]

b) Shifting {@shift@} units downwards,

[[jsxgraph input-ref-ansc='anscRef' input-ref-ansd='ansdRef']] JXG.Options.text.useMathJax = true; var board = JXG.JSXGraph.initBoard('jxgbox', {boundingbox: [-8, 8, 8, -8], axis:true, showCopyright:false, showNavigation:true }); var a = board.create('slider',[[-7.5,-4],[-4,-4],[-5,{#coeff_x+1#},5]],{name:'n', snapWidth:1}); var c = board.create('slider', [[-7.5, -5], [-4,-5], [-5, {#shift+1#}, 4]], {name:'c',snapWidth: 1}); var graph2 = board.create('functiongraph', [function(t) {return JXG.Math.pow(Math.E,t*a.Value())+ c.Value();}],{strokeColor:'#ff0000'}); var text = board.create('text', [-6, 6, function() { var aVal = a.Value().toFixed(2); var cVal = c.Value().toFixed(2); if (cVal < 0) { return '\\[f(x) = e^{' + aVal +'x} ' + cVal + '\\]'; } else { return '\\[f(x) = e^{' + aVal +'x} + ' + cVal + '\\]'; } }]); stack_jxg.bind_slider(anscRef, a); stack_jxg.bind_slider(ansdRef, c); board.update(); [[/jsxgraph]]

[[input:ansc]] [[validation:ansc]][[feedback:prtc]]

[[input:ansd]] [[validation:ansd]][[feedback:prtd]]

questionnote.text:
\(f(x)=e^{{@coeff_x@}x}\)

a) Reflecting about the x-axis,

\(f(x)=-e^{{@coeff_x@}x}\)

b) Shifting {@shift@} units downwards,

\(f(x)=e^{{@coeff_x@}x}-{@shift@}\)

c) Reflecting about the x-axis and then about the y-axis

\(f(x)=-e^{-{@coeff_x@}x}\)
